Policy.Title: Runtime policy
Policy.Scope: Changes apply to FileOps across this running host. They are kept in memory; restarting restores configured defaults. This form does not update host configuration files.
Policy.RootsHelper: One exact path per line. Defaults come from the working directory, application base directory, and process temporary directory.
Policy.EmptyRoots: An empty list restores the host's default roots; it does not block all access.
Policy.StartupHelper: An invalid, unavailable, or outside startup directory falls back to the first allowed root.
Policy.ReadOnlyHelper: Writes, uploads, edits, and deletes are blocked beneath these configured paths. Paths outside allowed roots are removed during normalization.
Policy.WriteHelper: Allows creating folders, uploading files, and saving text.
Policy.DeleteHelper: Deletion is independent of the write permission.
Policy.HiddenHelper: Allows access to hidden files and directories under the allowed roots.
Policy.TextMinimum: The text limit must be at least 4,096 bytes.
Policy.UploadMinimum: The upload limit must be at least 65,536 bytes.
Policy.DownloadLimitHelper: {0} · At least the upload limit; default 100 MiB.
Policy.DownloadMinimum: The download limit must be at least the upload limit.
Policy.EntriesHelper: Display cap 50–5,000; default 500. This is not a page size or total count.
Policy.EntryRange: Use a display cap from 50 to 5,000 entries.
Policy.ExtensionsHelper: Comma, semicolon, or newline separated. Restricts saving; preview also depends on size and text inspection.
Policy.NewerEdits: The captured policy was applied or reloaded. Your newer edits are retained and have not been applied.
Policy.ReadbackFailed: The policy update completed, but authoritative normalized values could not be reread. The draft remains available; reload current policy before treating these fields as accepted.
Policy.AccessDenied: Runtime policy access is unavailable under this host’s page access configuration. Return to Files or retry after access is restored.
